records.text: The anonymous email tipster said enhanced SUV images should make it possible to identify parts of the RØDE microphone body among the shards.
records.speaker: RØDE microphone shard email tipster (name unstated)

appearances.snippet: And if you can enhance the SUV images, I'm confident that you'll be able to identify parts of the microphone body by the shards.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed and live searches performed. This is an anonymous tipsters prediction about what image enhancement might reveal. No authenticated high-resolution image analysis or recovered microphone fragments establish the proposed identification.
